tests_added_or_updated: None added. This is a review-only phase; no new test module was authored. Existing test suites were re-run fresh (not reused) as regression evidence: 312 (136V+136W focused) + 2062 (cltr_cutover/schema_runtime, 8 skipped) + 32 (packaging) + 4391 (Fast Green), all passed.
summary: Phase 136X independently reviewed the complete Stage 3 executable-schema chapter (Groups 1-5, 8, 10, 11; Group 9 schema-less by design; Phases 136A through 136W) as one coherent system, per CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 and CLTR-CUTOVER-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0. Confirmed 16 record schemas, 7 shared resources, 23 manifest entries, 24 registry resources, no Group 12, and a strict group-boundary DAG with zero cross-group cycles. Clarified the frozen contract's Sec.46 table uses group numbers {1,2,3,4,5,8,9,10,11} only -- there was never a contract-defined Group 6 or Group 7 -- and that Group 9 is genuinely schema-less by design. Consolidated a deduplicated finding register spanning NON-BLOCKING-136N-7, BLOCKING-136U-1 (repaired), DEFERRED-136T-1 (staleness_check), NON-BLOCKING-136V-1 through -6, DEFERRED-136V-1 (retirement_state), CONFIRMED-136W-1/-2, and NON-BLOCKING-136W-3 (full-suite stall), plus two new findings of its own: a stale cltr_cutover/README.md (corrected in place, documentation-only) and the Groups-6/7 clarification. Independently derived the typed-model contract (Sec.44 of CLTR-CUTOVER-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0) and a 14-item typed-model hazard analysis without implementing any model, dataclass, or fixture. Classified 15 candidate semantic-validation rules against the frozen contract's Sec.47 six-layer validation stack, distinguishing observation-viable Layer 4/5 rules from Layer-6 authority-truth rules explicitly out of scope. Reviewed the derived-view boundary: none authorized yet, none created. Evaluated four candidate next-layer sequences and selected: since typed-model architecture and contract are already frozen and independently verified (136A), the next phase should be a Stage 3 Typed Authority Model Implementation Plan (analogous to 136E), not further architecture (redundant) and not implementation (premature without a governed plan). Fresh regression evidence: 312 (136V+136W focused) + 2062 (cltr_cutover/schema_runtime, 8 skipped) + 32 (packaging) + 4391 (Fast Green) all passed, zero regressions. Re-attempted the full unmarked suite fresh under a 240-second bound; it again did not complete -- the fourth independently observed stall across 136W and this phase -- classified as inherited, pre-existing instability unrelated to the schema track, since every schema/runtime/packaging-adjacent test passes to completion in isolation every time it has been run. A bounded future investigation is recommended, not required, and does not block next-layer readiness. No production schema was changed. No typed model, semantic validator, derived view, persistence, resolver, or runtime authority behavior was implemented. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Verdict: EXECUTABLE-SCHEMA TRACK CLOSED WITH READINESS LIMITATIONS -- NEXT-LAYER PREREQUISITES REQUIRED. Recommended next phase: 136Y -- Stage 3 Typed Authority Model Implementation Plan.
